admission_boundaries.pr_86: OPEN_DRAFT_UNMERGED; future PR86-INTEGRATION-RECONCILIATION must compare accepted Recovery implementation/evidence with the frozen baseline and decide merge/rebase/selective transplant/replacement separately.

provider_configuration.rule: Material provider, configuration, language, recording-path or second-speaker change requires prospective revalidation before use outside the admitted owner scope.

scope_limitations: Historical RU 17/179 (9.4972%) met its bounded criterion; EN 37/181 (20.4420%) failed the frozen 18% benchmark and remains a measured limitation under OD-62D-EN-01.
Owner-only acceptance does not expand to other speakers, users, devices, noise conditions, languages or external release; second-speaker revalidation is required before expansion.
Pronunciation timestamps have bounded structural evidence only; accuracy, device energy, thermal and broad provider quality are not established.
Consent, deletion, ownership, immutable transcript versions, media preflight, backend isolation and provider-independent interfaces still require implementation and attributable runtime tests.
